30th September – Inauguration & Elimination Written Quiz - Annual Inter-School Science Quiz Contest 2026-27

On 30th September, Rotary Club of Bombay Pier, Nehru Science Centre and RC of Bombay Queen City inaugurated the Annual Inter-School Science Quiz Contest at Nehru Science Centre.

The program included Welcome Address by Shri Shuba Sankar Ghose, Director, Nehru Science Centre, Lighting of the Lamp by the guests, followed by address by Rtn Amit Gupta, President of RCBP and address by Rtn Hiren Gosalia, President of RC of Bombay Queen City.
We have received registrations from around 154 schools, with nearly 700 participants, including approximately 650 students along with their teachers, expected to attend the programme.
The inauguration was attended by President Rtn Amit Gupta and Rtn Sonal Pangoriya.

The project cost is Rs 4 lakhs which is shared equally shared by both the Rotary Clubs.

Our Club’s share Rs 2 lakhs.
